key_notes: Key 1 (t=1.54s): Initial archival pose of binoculars; Quick, Draw! + Rotoscope centerline established.
Key 2 (t=2.67s): Mid-sequence articulation of binoculars; 2x2 smooth cage tracks primary motion.
Key 3 (t=3.9s): Peak dynamic extension of binoculars over 7-plane multiplane environment.
Key 4 (t=5.14s): Follow-through and settle of binoculars with watertight SAM cel backing.
why_continuous: Continuous 3.6s archival shot of binoculars (1.54s..5.14s) selected by edge clarity and temporal coherence.
